title: Derive merged_unreleased_claims and orphaned_branches in status
description: status currently stubs merged_unreleased_claims and orphaned_branches as empty arrays. Derive them for real: a claim whose branch is already merged into main but whose claim file still exists is merged-unreleased; an agent/TASK-* branch with no matching claim or queue task is orphaned.
acceptance_criteria: status lists claims whose branch is merged into main but not yet released
status lists agent/* branches that have no live claim
integration test exercises at least one of the two derivations
